content.summary: Operations leader with 12 years of experience directing FMCG distribution, route-to-market improvements, inventory governance, and frontline teams across Tanzania.

experience.title: Regional Operations Manager
bullets: Directed 86 employees across four depots, improving order fulfilment from 87% to 96%.
Reduced inventory variance by 38% through cycle-count controls and warehouse accountability routines.
Negotiated transport capacity agreements that lowered cost per delivery by 17% across the Lake Zone.

experience.title: Supply Chain Manager
bullets: Designed demand-planning routines for 1,200 SKUs, reducing stock-outs by 29%.
Led ERP inventory migration for five warehouses, completing implementation four weeks ahead of schedule.

education.credential: Bachelor of Science in Procurement and Logistics Management
